# port-lists

Port lists.

- Toolset name: `port-lists`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 5 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_port_list`

**Create port list** · mutating

Create a port list from a range expression like "T:1-1000,U:53,T:8080". Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Port list name |
| `port_range` | string | no | Port range expression, e.g. "T:1-1000,U:53" |

### `openvas_delete_port_list`

**Delete port list** · destructive

Delete a port list (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if a target still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_port_list`

**Get port list** · read-only

Get one port list by UUID, including its port ranges.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_port_lists`

**List port lists** · read-only

List port lists targets can scan.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_port_list`

**Update port list** · destructive

Update a port list's name, comment or ranges. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the port list to update |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `port_range` | string | no | Replacement port range expression, e.g. "T:1-1000,U:53" |
